subject: bell-bodied glass penguin
art_direction: 企鹅身体像青绿玻璃铃，奶白腹面与扁圆双足，微微前倾。
visible_description: 企鹅身体像青绿玻璃铃，奶白腹面与扁圆双足，微微前倾。
composition: Square 1024x1024 avatar. The distinct subject, face, object or abstract form occupies about 65–80% of the canvas, and remains readable at small size. Important features sit safely near the center with room for a circular crop, but DO NOT draw a circular frame, badge, disc backdrop or circular mask. Render a complete square background. Vary silhouette, expression, angle, asymmetry, and density as the individual direction requests. Appealing eyes and a purposeful expression matter when a face is present; never force a face onto a faceless concept.
creative_direction: Design a penguin whose body resembles a low bell of satin teal glass. A milky cream belly panel curves around the front, above two flattened clear-glass feet. It leans slightly forward with one small wing opened, showing attentive curiosity. Keep the head continuous with the body and the face understated. Use a pale cool-gray backdrop and diffused overhead light, avoiding bright caustics, snow, or plastic gloss. Square 1024x1024, with a clear central silhouette and no circular border. Original peaceful design, no lettering, logos, or watermark.
